verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Greenhouse has an onboarding module with milestones and a 'Candidate hired' webhook event. Neither shows a signed offer's data flowing into onboarding or into HRIS/payroll systems without re-entry. The webhook is a developer building block and the onboarding milestones are an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit; no first-party HRIS or payroll integration is documented.

support.subject: As an operations lead, a signed offer flows into onboarding — HRIS and payroll integrations carry the new hire's data over without re-entry
